title: deepseek-pp-local-runtime v1
description: Language-neutral contract for the DeepSeek++ Local Coding Runtime native host (com.deepseek_pp.runtime.canary). P1C2: background authorization is the sole authority; grant_id is correlation-only and workspace_id is a background-owned binding hint (both model-invisible). Production advertises canary.echo only; canary.spawn_sleeper is test-internal.

grant_id.description: Background-owned internal correlation ticket only (model-invisible). Never authorization evidence; the host never gates on non-empty strings.

workspace_id.description: Background-owned internal workspace binding hint only (receiver-owned). The host still canonicalizes, verifies existence/directory, and fails closed.

profile_id.description: Host-owned execution profile. Production: canary.echo only. canary.spawn_sleeper is test-internal (requires DEEPSEEK_PP_RUNTIME_ALLOW_TEST_PROFILES=1).
